title: Kilobyte Marketplace Web App
description: A comprehensive Django marketplace for posting, browsing, and managing local product listings.
problem: Local buyers and sellers in my community lacked a reliable, centralized platform to list products and search by specific categories or cities, often relying on fragmented social media posts.
built: I designed the entire backend using Django, including custom product models and category relationships. I implemented the media upload flow for product images, user authentication, and seller profile pages. I also built the search and filtering logic to improve product discoverability.

title: Kilobyte Notebook & Kibo AI
description: A Django-powered note-taking workspace with an integrated AI assistant named Kibo.
problem: Students need a way to organize notes efficiently and get instant help with concepts without switching tabs.
built: I built the note-taking core and integrated 'Kibo', an AI Note Assistant that helps with markdown, folder organization, and general queries. The app features real-time chat, trash recovery, and a mobile-responsive interface.

title: Campus News Mobile App
description: A comprehensive mobile application for university news, academic headlines, and campus exploration.
problem: Students struggle to find centralized information about orientation programmes, campus events, and academic updates, leading to missed opportunities.
built: I developed the Flutter frontend featuring a dynamic Headlines feed (including NUST Orientation notices), an Explore menu with 8 categories (Academics, Sports, Clubs, Tech, etc.), and a robust Settings module for profile and notification management.

title: Professional Portfolio Dashboard
description: A sleek, data-driven portfolio dashboard built to showcase professional skills and project evidence.
problem: Generic portfolios lack the structured, dashboard-like feel that quickly communicates a developer's full range of capabilities to recruiters.
built: I designed and built this custom dashboard using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features a JSON-powered project system, theme switching, responsive layouts, and an accessible navigation structure designed for maximum clarity.
